# Shyam Neon Sign — Custom LED Neon Sign Maker in Kanpur

> Shyam Neon Sign is a custom LED neon sign manufacturer located at 109/385, R.K. Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India. We craft personalized LED neon name signs, business and commercial shop logo neon boards, smart RGB color-changing neon lights, and festive signage.

## Standard Specifications
- **Tubing:** 2nd-Gen flexible silicone LED neon (shatterproof, cool-touch, silent, energy-efficient)
- **Backboard:** 5mm laser-cut clear acrylic, matte black acrylic, or ACP commercial backing (cut-to-shape or rectangular)
- **Power & Accessories:** Safe 12V Indian plug-and-play power adapter, transparent cable, pre-drilled holes, and stainless steel mounting screws included
- **Upgrades:** Brightness dimmer, Bluetooth app + music-sync RGB controller, UV logo printing + LED neon hybrid, and Outdoor IP65 waterproof build
